# S6.3 reference-import fixtures

One fixture set for the reference-import flow characterization
(`tests/test_s6_3_reference_import.cpp`, golden
`tests/golden/s6_3_reference_report.txt`).

Systematization of fixtures across flows is owned by S4b-main; this
directory preempts nothing — it is the single set the S6.3 brief
requires, generated byte-deterministically by
`tools/gen_s6_3_fixtures.py` (re-running it reproduces every file
byte-for-byte).

| file | purpose |
|---|---|
| `ref_happy_c_major.mid` | happy path: 2 bars C/F triads + 2 drum hits, parses Ok, `enough_data=true` |
| `ref_too_little.mid` | single note: parses Ok, `enough_data=false` (adopt disabled) |
| `ref_empty.mid` | 0 bytes: Editor "unreadable file" branch (taken before parsing) |
| `ref_truncated.mid` | 6 bytes: `SmfError::Truncated` |
| `ref_bad_header.mid` | 20 non-magic bytes: `SmfError::BadHeader` |
| `ref_unsupported_type.mid` | format-2 header: `SmfError::UnsupportedType` |
| `ref_bad_event.mid` | bare data byte, no running status: `SmfError::BadEvent` |

There is deliberately NO oversize-limit fixture: the reader applies no
cap (`midi_read.h` "No bar/note caps"), so a limit test would invent
behavior. Large-file cost is timing-only and untraced (see the test).
